bio:
Skye joined The Pet Studio Training Academy in 2020 after realising that her future belonged in professional dog grooming. She completed her City & Guilds Level 2 qualification and has since become a valued groomer and teaching assistant.

Her calm, compassionate nature makes her particularly well suited to puppies and dogs who feel nervous or uncertain in the salon. Skye gives them time to settle and works patiently to create a positive experience. She also specialises in ultrasonic teeth cleaning. Away from the salon, Skye shares her life with Marnie the Rottweiler and Chihuahuas Pixie and Cookie.
